title: carya ovata f. halesii
intro: Carya ovata f. halesii, commonly known as Shagbark Hickory, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the Juglandaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Carya ovata f. halesii include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which exert therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory effects.
